description: This file provides a verifiable random number generator (RNG) implementation, particularly for dice rolls, with capabilities for generating audit records and verifying commitment hashes. It includes functions for generating and verifying dice rolls, using cryptographic techniques for auditability, and defines data structures for audit records.

classes.name: DiceAuditRecord
classes.description: Immutable data class representing an audit record for dice rolls, including details such as match ID, player ID, turn number, timestamp, nonce, commitment hash, and dice value.

classes.name: VerifiableRngService
classes.description: Service class providing methods to generate and verify auditable dice rolls using cryptographic commitment schemes.

methods.name: int _now_ms()
methods.description: Returns the current time in milliseconds.

methods.name: str _require_salt()
methods.description: Retrieves the RNG audit salt from configuration, raising an error if not configured.

methods.name: str _hmac_sha256_hex(*, key: str, msg: str)
methods.description: Computes an HMAC SHA256 digest of a message with a given key, returning the hex-encoded string.

methods.name: DiceAuditRecord roll_d6(self, *, match_id: str, player_id: str, turn_no: int)
methods.description: Generates a verifiable random dice roll (1-6), along with an audit record containing the commitment details.

methods.name: bool verify_record(self, record: DiceAuditRecord)
methods.description: Verifies the integrity and correctness of a stored dice audit record by recomputing the commitment hash and comparing it.

methods.name: VerifiableRngService get_rng_service()
methods.description: Provides a singleton-like instance of the VerifiableRngService.

ctags.name: roll_d6
ctags.pattern: /^    def roll_d6(self, *, match_id: str, player_id: str, turn_no: int) -> DiceAuditRecord:$/
ctags.signature: (self, *, match_id: str, player_id: str, turn_no: int)
